local_bottleneck: Founders must be Tunisians or foreigners legally resident in Tunisia; local office and resident representative required

foreign_donor_restriction: Foreign associations need branch registration + resident rep; 2023 draft adds Foreign Ministry authorisation
corrections: Confirm prior; governing text is Decree-Law 59-154 of 1959; only 2 founders needed; members 13+, must accept bylaws in writing
